own_solution.law: Force on dielectric slab at constant voltage: F = (1/2) V^2 dC/dx, with C(x) = C0 [1 + (kappa-1) x/L]
assumptions: slab well inside the plate ends

TA3FF.regime: 0 < inserted length < plate length (10 cm), edge away from the ends

TAC6D.regime: 0 < inserted length < plate length (10 cm), edge away from the ends

notes: Base 0.75 mN matches my 7.5e-4 N. R answers: 650 V -> 0.5*422500*6e-9 = 1.2675 mN; 850 V -> 2.1675 mN; 1200 V -> 4.32 mN, all correct. In pass 1 I classed the insertion depth as C; the authors' K, with regime q < ell, is equally or more apt, since the force vanishes once the slab fills the plates. The listed 2.5/4.5/6.5 cm all lie inside that regime. I now accept K, and the label difference is not a defect. Minimal pairs T09BD/TBFE0 and TABCB/TE652 share 350 V and differ only in attachment; T9C5B and T8F88 are declared numeral-free twins.
